logo.description: A flat vector agate bean drawn from the illustrated packaging bean: an S-shaped crease, rippled agate layers that follow each half of the bean, thin cream veins and a glossy highlight, in roast, amber, honey, sand and cream.
rules: Use the full-colour bean by default, on olive, sage, cream or dark backgrounds.
Use the one-colour olive or cream bean where only one ink is possible, such as stamps, engraving or embroidery.
Keep the original proportions and the transparent background; do not add a backing shape or recolour the layers.
Leave clear space around the bean of at least one quarter of its width.
The painted illustration and the script wordmark remain the packaging artwork; the flat bean is for interfaces, favicons and small sizes.
Regenerate the SVGs with scripts/make_logo.py instead of editing them by hand.
